scene.agriculture.001.name: Field inspection log
scene.agriculture.001.problem: Paper inspection notes get lost and history is hard to trace. Capture results in forms, auto-archive by plot and date, and search later.
scene.agriculture.002.name: Farming calendar
scene.agriculture.002.problem: Field work relies on tribal knowledge. Show sowing, fertilizing, and spraying plans on a calendar and log actual execution.
scene.agriculture.003.name: Sowing record
scene.agriculture.003.problem: Sowing data is scattered. Record variety, area, and seed batch to build a traceable sowing archive.
scene.agriculture.004.name: Irrigation record
scene.agriculture.004.problem: Irrigation is guesswork without numbers. Log time, volume, and method to improve water plans.
scene.agriculture.005.name: Fertilizer & spray log
scene.agriculture.005.problem: Ag-input use has no ledger. Record type, dose, and time for each application to evaluate ROI.
scene.agriculture.006.name: Harvest registration
scene.agriculture.006.problem: Harvest totals lag when counted by hand. Register variety, quantity, and plot for live yield rollups.
scene.agriculture.007.name: Pest & disease report
scene.agriculture.007.problem: Farmers cannot report pests quickly, delaying control. Capture location, crop, and symptom photos to open work orders.
scene.agriculture.008.name: Surveillance data capture
scene.agriculture.008.problem: Manual trap-station logs err and do not roll up live. Enter light-trap, pheromone, and weather data to auto-build trends.
scene.agriculture.009.name: Unified pest-control dispatch
scene.agriculture.009.problem: Unified control jobs are assigned by phone. Publish tasks by form with chemical, area, and crew for full traceability.
scene.agriculture.010.name: Drone spray operation log
scene.agriculture.010.problem: UAV spray jobs lack digital records. Log flight params, spray volume, and time linked to each plot.
scene.agriculture.011.name: Quarantine declaration
scene.agriculture.011.problem: Plant quarantine filings are paper-heavy. Submit origin and transfer info online and sync to the quarantine system.
scene.agriculture.012.name: Ag-input stock in/out
scene.agriculture.012.problem: Manual stock books lag. Record in/out on forms so inventory stays current for purchase and allocation.
scene.agriculture.013.name: Seed batch traceability
scene.agriculture.013.problem: Seed batch data is fragmented. Register batches end-to-end from inbound to use for quality control.
scene.agriculture.014.name: Machinery dispatch
scene.agriculture.014.problem: Machine dispatch runs by phone with opaque progress. Use dispatch sheets and live location/status tracking.
scene.agriculture.015.name: Maintenance & service log
scene.agriculture.015.problem: No maintenance history means mid-season breakdowns. Build service records with due-date reminders.
scene.agriculture.016.name: Fuel consumption log
scene.agriculture.016.problem: Missing fuel data blocks cost accounting. Log refuels per machine for cost analytics.
scene.agriculture.017.name: Subsidy application
scene.agriculture.017.problem: Offline forms miss fields. Submit online with automatic checks on area and document completeness.
scene.agriculture.018.name: Area verification & correction
scene.agriculture.018.problem: When remote sensing disagrees with self-reported area, verify manually and notify corrections to stop fraud.
scene.agriculture.019.name: Public-notice objection handling
scene.agriculture.019.problem: During public notice, farmers may dispute subsidy lists. Look up policy basis quickly and record feedback.
scene.agriculture.020.name: Subsidy payout confirmation
scene.agriculture.020.problem: After payout, confirm receipt household by household to avoid stalled or stolen funds.
scene.agriculture.021.name: Policy Q&A (RAG)
scene.agriculture.021.problem: Farmers and grassroots staff read subsidy rules differently. Answer precisely from a curated knowledge base.
scene.agriculture.022.name: Purchase-order intake
scene.agriculture.022.problem: Buyer and farmer orders are opaque. Digitize order entry and lists to track purchase progress end-to-end.
scene.agriculture.023.name: Cold-chain handover log
scene.agriculture.023.problem: Missing temperature logs at handover cause quality disputes. Record time, temperature, and dual signatures.
scene.agriculture.024.name: Traceability code batch mgmt
scene.agriculture.024.problem: Trace codes are scattered. Enter and query batches so one code covers the full chain.
scene.agriculture.025.name: Quality sampling log
scene.agriculture.025.problem: Paper QC results do not link to batches. Capture tests, results, and photos into an electronic quality file.
scene.agriculture.026.name: Market price log
scene.agriculture.026.problem: Prices swing without history. Log variety, market, and price for query and analysis.
scene.agriculture.027.name: Weather alert config
scene.agriculture.027.problem: Extreme weather alerts arrive too late. Auto-push WeCom alerts and keep an alert history.
scene.agriculture.028.name: Soil-moisture dashboard
scene.agriculture.028.problem: Moisture readings are scattered. Chart regional trends and live drought status.
scene.agriculture.029.name: Yield forecast Q&A
scene.agriculture.029.problem: Managers want yield forecasts without SQL. Ask in natural language; the system queries and answers.
scene.agriculture.030.name: Agronomy knowledge base
scene.agriculture.030.problem: Tech materials are scattered. Build a structured KB with full-text search and category browse.

scene.med.001.name: Symptom pre-consult
scene.med.001.problem: Patients misdescribe symptoms before registration. AI NLP pre-consult captures chief complaint, history, allergies and suggests a department — doctor confirms.
scene.med.002.name: ED triage assist
scene.med.002.problem: ED acuity relies on nurse experience. AI suggests ESI-level triage from vitals, complaint, and red flags — nurse confirms.
scene.med.003.name: Triage todo closed loop
scene.med.003.problem: After triage desk intake, follow-up exams and referrals get lost. AI creates and tracks nurse-station todos.
scene.med.004.name: Follow-up booking guide
scene.med.004.problem: Post-discharge revisit rates are low. AI recommends department and time from discharge orders — patient or nurse confirms.
scene.med.005.name: Chief-complaint structuring
scene.med.005.problem: Free-text complaints hurt DRG coding. AI NLP structures symptom, site, time, and nature for the chart.
scene.med.006.name: Allergy history capture
scene.med.006.problem: Incomplete allergies cause med errors. Conversational NLP captures allergens and reactions for HIS — doctor confirms.
scene.med.007.name: Red-flag symptom alert
scene.med.007.problem: Hidden red flags (chest pain, stroke) are missed. AI NLP alerts the nurse station and suggests urgent triage.
scene.med.008.name: Pediatric triage routing
scene.med.008.problem: Peds acuity changes fast. Rules engine suggests level and department from age, symptoms, and fever — nurse confirms.
scene.med.009.name: Shift-swap conflict check
scene.med.009.problem: Manual swap checks miss consecutive night limits. Constraint solver detects conflicts and proposes compliant swaps.
scene.med.010.name: Charge-nurse approval
scene.med.010.problem: Swap/leave/OT approvals stuck on paper/PC. AI summarizes conflicts and suggests approve/deny — charge nurse decides.
scene.med.011.name: Roster overview
scene.med.011.problem: Ward roster tables are hard to read. Auto Gantt/heatmap highlights coverage gaps without editing the roster.
scene.med.012.name: Flexible overtime roster
scene.med.012.problem: Nurses want preferred OT slots. Forecast demand and preferences, then publish after charge-nurse OK.
scene.med.013.name: Night-shift handover list
scene.med.013.problem: Night handovers miss critical patients/meds. RAG builds a structured checklist from history and SOP.
scene.med.014.name: Staffing load board
scene.med.014.problem: No live nurse-to-patient load view. Dashboard computes load from roster + HIS and warns overload windows.
scene.med.015.name: Leave-linked backfill
scene.med.015.problem: Leave leaves holes. Recommend qualified backfill nurses and raise an approval for the charge nurse.
scene.med.016.name: Guideline retrieval
scene.med.016.problem: Bedside guideline lookup is slow. RAG returns cited guideline snippets for clinician reference only.
scene.med.017.name: Drug insert Q&A
scene.med.017.problem: Paper inserts get lost. RAG answers from the drug-label KB — pharmacist still reviews.
scene.med.018.name: Clinical pathway reference
scene.med.018.problem: Pathways live in many systems. Vector search returns pathway steps for standardization support.
scene.med.019.name: Nursing SOP lookup
scene.med.019.problem: New nurses need quick SOP steps. RAG retrieves nursing SOP text for procedure guidance.
scene.med.020.name: Case-conference notes
scene.med.020.problem: Hard-case notes are scattered. RAG retrieves and summarizes discussion minutes.
scene.med.021.name: CME question bank
scene.med.021.problem: Exam prep banks are fragmented. Vector search returns practice items by topic.
scene.med.022.name: Antimicrobial Q&A
scene.med.022.problem: Stewardship rules are long. RAG answers from antimicrobial guidance — culture and clinician decide.
scene.med.023.name: Critical-value explainer
scene.med.023.problem: Nurses need fast meaning of lab criticals. RAG explains significance — clinician still acts.
scene.med.024.name: Adverse-event report
scene.med.024.problem: AE reporting is heavy and under-reported. Rules pre-fill forms from HIS/LIS anomalies into QC workflow.
scene.med.025.name: IPC round & corrective action
scene.med.025.problem: Infection-control rounds stay on paper. NLP extracts issues and assigns corrective tasks.
scene.med.026.name: QC SOP checklist
scene.med.026.problem: SOP audits are manual. Mobile forms compare results to SOP and write defect reports.
scene.med.027.name: Clinical todo hub
scene.med.027.problem: Todos scatter across HIS/LIS/PACS. Aggregate and IM-remind — clinicians still act.
scene.med.028.name: IPC early warning push
scene.med.028.problem: MDR/infection signals lag. Rules on LIS micro results push IM alerts to IPC and wards.
scene.med.029.name: Hand-hygiene spot check
scene.med.029.problem: Compliance audits are paper-based. Mobile capture auto-computes compliance trends.
scene.med.030.name: High-alert med double-check
scene.med.030.problem: Insulin/chemo checks are error-prone. Scan/NLP match to orders and log the check.
scene.med.031.name: Consult request
scene.med.031.problem: Paper consults are slow. Rules match department/doctor and LLM drafts a summary for HIS.
scene.med.032.name: MDT request
scene.med.032.problem: MDT scheduling is hard. RAG templates plus conflict checks organize slots — not treatment decisions.
scene.med.033.name: Surgery approval
scene.med.033.problem: Multi-level surgery sign-off is paper-slow. Rules route by surgery class and extract key fields.
scene.med.034.name: Bed coordination
scene.med.034.problem: Bed crunch is manual. Recommend beds from occupancy forecasts — clinician assigns.
scene.med.035.name: Critical-value notify
scene.med.035.problem: Critical labs arrive late. Rules + webhook push to clinician IM and log receipt.
scene.med.036.name: Transfusion approval
scene.med.036.problem: Blood-type matching checks are manual. Rules validate match and summarize rationale.
scene.med.037.name: High-value supply trace
scene.med.037.problem: Stents/implants need full chain. Barcode/RFID + rules link supply to patient in HIS/LIS.
scene.med.038.name: Device purchase approval
scene.med.038.problem: Multi-level device purchase is slow. Rank priority from utilization history into OA — humans approve.
scene.med.039.name: Maintenance-due reminder
scene.med.039.problem: Missed PM causes downtime. Rules scan asset ledger and notify 30 days ahead.
scene.med.040.name: Metrology-due reminder
scene.med.040.problem: Calibration overdue risks compliance. Rules notify biomed and clinical owners before due.
scene.med.041.name: Sterile-pack trace
scene.med.041.problem: CSSD packs need wash-to-issue trail. Barcode + rules log each step — quality judgment stays human.
scene.med.042.name: Dept ops dashboard
scene.med.042.problem: Ops KPIs lag on spreadsheets. NL2SQL aggregates visit/bed/ALOS boards with drill-down.
scene.med.043.name: Natural-language query
scene.med.043.problem: Clinicians cannot write SQL. NL2SQL answers questions like top clinics by volume — data only.
scene.med.044.name: Bed occupancy analysis
scene.med.044.problem: Bed stats are manual. Live occupancy, turnover, and ETA-free boards from HIS.
scene.med.045.name: Outpatient volume trend
scene.med.045.problem: Volume swings lack forecasts. Time-series trends and YoY/MoM for staffing support.
scene.med.046.name: ALOS analysis
scene.med.046.problem: Long ALOS hurts DRG. Association mining finds delay factors — not clinical pathway edits.
scene.med.047.name: DRG group overview
scene.med.047.problem: DRG mix is hard to see. Cluster case-mix, cost, and ALOS for ops — not outcomes scoring.
scene.med.048.name: Data masking & authorization
scene.med.048.problem: Sensitive fields leak by role. RBAC rules dynamically mask ID/name in HIS reads.
scene.med.049.name: LIS critical push
scene.med.049.problem: Nurses refresh HIS for criticals. Webhook from LIS pushes WeCom/DingTalk to owners.
scene.med.050.name: Privacy compliance Q&A
scene.med.050.problem: Staff unsure about privacy rules. RAG answers from hospital policies — not legal advice.
scene.med.051.name: HIS–LIS sync check
scene.med.051.problem: Order/result mismatches. NL2SQL diff detects conflicts and suggests fixes — no auto-write.
scene.med.052.name: Role permission admin
scene.med.052.problem: Onboarding needs many system roles. Rules generate RBAC packs from job templates — admin approves.
